title: Sunny and the Morning Mist | Bedtime Story
description: Join Sonny the Quokka as she watches the first soft evening mist roll quietly through the valley, turning the whole bush into something silver and dreamy. A gentle bedtime story from Sonny's Cozy Quokka Bedtime Tales, made for little ones drifting off to sleep.
narration:
When the sun slips away, the valley begins to fill with mist.

Sunny the little quokka stepped outside into the cool evening air. She could see something soft moving between the trees. Pale and quiet, like a gentle breath from the earth.

The mist came slowly. So slowly. It crept along the ground like a sleepy river. It curled around the roots of the old gum trees. It filled the hollow between the hills, soft and silver and still.

Sunny watched it come. She did not move. She just stood very quietly and breathed it in. The air smelled like wet leaves and cool soil and something that had no name at all.

The mist rose a little higher. It touched the tips of the grasses. It drifted past the round white stones by the creek. It made everything look far away and soft, like a dream that was just beginning.

Sunny took one small step forward. The mist wrapped gently around her paws. It was cool and light, almost like nothing at all.

She smiled her big warm smile.

She sat down right there at the edge of the hollow. She watched the mist fill and fill and fill the valley below. The stars began to appear above, tiny and bright. The mist glowed softly underneath them.

Sunny's eyes grew heavy. She rested her cheek on her paws. The valley was so still. The mist was so soft.

She let her eyes close, and the whole world turned to silver.

Goodnight, Sunny. Goodnight, mist. Goodnight, little one.
